criteria.criterion: Access legislation.gov.uk and reach Data Protection Act 2018 in Original (As enacted) Introductory Text (or clearly report blocker)
criteria.final_justification: The agent demonstrably reached the Introduction/Introductory Text content, and there is clear evidence (Screenshot 3 + the /enacted URL in action history) that the session is in the Original (As enacted) version. This satisfies the navigation requirement.

criteria.criterion: Record chapter number exactly as displayed (as enacted)
criteria.final_justification: Agent’s reported chapter number matches the on-screen text exactly.

criteria.criterion: Record complete long title exactly as displayed (as enacted)
criteria.final_justification: Agent’s long title matches the displayed text (including punctuation and “Commissioner’s”).

criteria.criterion: Record Royal Assent date exactly as displayed (as enacted)
criteria.final_justification: Agent’s Royal Assent date matches exactly as displayed, including brackets and ordinal suffix.

criteria.criterion: Count top-level Parts in as-enacted table of contents (Parts only, exclude nested Parts in Schedules)
criteria.final_justification: Although the agent’s answer of 7 Parts is plausibly correct for this Act, the provided visual evidence does not substantiate that the agent actually verified/counts all top-level Parts from the as-enacted ToC. Award partial credit for giving the correct number but without evidentiary support in the screenshots.

criteria.criterion: Count top-level Schedules in as-enacted table of contents (each counted once)
criteria.final_justification: The agent’s reported schedule count (20) is unsupported by any screenshot evidence, and the record provides no basis to verify it from the as-enacted ToC. This is treated as an unsubstantiated/likely incorrect claim, so no credit.
